name: IndieHunt
conditions: Free Launch shares a pool of 15 slots per week — pick a launch week early
Free tier requires the IndieHunt badge on your website (verification step in the flow)
Free project link is nofollow by default; only top-3 weekly winners on Free can earn dofollow
requirements: AI tool or indie SaaS positioning
Weekly competition format: launches go live Monday 8:00 AM UTC for a 7-day competition
preparation: Project details, website URL, and categories
IndieHunt badge embedded if using Free
Chosen launch week aligned with your marketing plan
Community ready for launch-week upvotes and comments (ranking is upvote-driven; top 3 earn Hall of Fame badges)
workflow: Sign in with email, Google, or GitHub
Add project details, website URL, and categories
Pick a launch week and complete badge verification or payment
Go live Monday 8:00 AM UTC for a 7-day competition
watchFor: Only 15 free slots per week — the week you want may be full; Premium is unlimited
Free links are nofollow — if the backlink is the goal, a $19 Premium is guaranteed dofollow
Premium includes site-wide ad slots, an SEO launch blog post, and 9 launch-kit PNGs
'Premium Launcher' partner licence exists for bulk launches across the Hunt network
countsAsLive: Project appears on the IndieHunt homepage/launch listing for its chosen week starting Monday 8:00 AM UTC with upvote/comment controls active
unknowns: Whether free submissions get a manual quality review before scheduling
